name: Prize Claw
summary: A neon arcade 404 page where the lost page fell into a claw machine and you play to win it back
about: A full not-found page with a playable claw machine at its heart. Plushies, bouncy balls and a gold 404 capsule tumble into the glass with real physics; each plush you win is a link out of the page, and the gold capsule brings your page back with confetti. A search box finds pages directly and makes the matching plushies glow in the machine.
how: The marquee flickers on and the prizes rain into the machine, then the claw plays a demo round by itself
Move the claw with the arrow keys, the on-screen arrows or by dragging on the glass, and press Drop or Space
The claw closes, lifts and carries your prize to the chute; sometimes it slips, just like a real one
Each win slides out of the prize door with a link and lands on your Prize shelf; credits run out, so insert a coin
Win the gold 404 capsule to get your page back with a confetti finish, then refill the machine to play again
Or type in Search instead to list matching pages while their plushies glow inside the glass
